hook_line: ADANI GROUP UNVEILS $120 BILLION CAPEX PLAN OVER FIVE YEARS

hook_stat.sub: Capex planned over the next five years across all group businesses

diaspora_bullets: The plan covers all group businesses, not only Adani Enterprises
The group estimates core earnings of Rs 2.6-3 lakh crore in five years
news_summary: Adani Group executives told Fortune India they plan to invest about $120 billion in capital expenditure over the next five years, more than $20 billion a year, across all group businesses.
payoff: The figures are a plan, not a result: the group estimates the spending would double its asset base to Rs 18 lakh crore.
